name: Chlorium
description: Experimental CPU/GPU renderer for GD 2.2081; independent Bismuth fork

ingame_enable.name: Compatibility diagnostics
ingame_enable.description: Keeps native CPU updates for diagnostics. F3 toggles performance information; may reduce performance.

use_mapped_buffers.name: Use mapped buffer uploads
use_mapped_buffers.description: Maps GPU buffers only while uploading data, then unmaps before drawing. Performance depends on your graphics driver.
